quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: Quit, don't quit. Noodles, don't noodles... You are too concerned with what was and what will be. There's a saying: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift. That is why it is called the present.
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: Your story may not have such a happy beginning, but that doesn't make you who you are. It is the rest of your story, who you choose to be.
quotes.author: Soothsayer

quotes.text: You are ready. I've never been more sure of anything.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: See, that's the thing, Shen. Scars heal.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: Now, who wants to do the right thing for the wrong reasons?
quotes.author: Zhen

quotes.text: My time has come. You must now continue your journey without me. You must believe...
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: Who are you? ... I've been asking the same question. Am I the son of a panda? The son of a goose? A student? A teacher? Turns out, I'm all of them.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: Ah, Shifu. There is just news. There is no good or bad.
quotes.author: Master Oogway
